text.en: CoCoOP is row 66 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the LLM area.
text.zh: CoCoOP 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 66 行，所属领域为“大语言模型”。

text.en: The annual table associates CoCoOP with “Conditional Prompt Learning for Vision-Language Models”.
text.zh: 年度表把 CoCoOP 与论文《Conditional Prompt Learning for Vision-Language Models》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Kaiyang Zhou, Ziwei Liu”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 Kaiyang Zhou（官方页拼写）、Ziwei Liu（官方页拼写）；官方英文原文为“Kaiyang Zhou, Ziwei Liu”。
